title: Abductive class refinement and attention holding for small aerial targets: code, reports and derived data
description: Reference implementation, reproduction scripts, saved reports and derived data for the articles of V. Yu. Nareznoy (Odesa Polytechnic National University): (3) "Abductive refinement of the airborne object class based on the groundability principle of perceptual facts"; (4a) "Separating the holding and decision thresholds for tracking small aerial targets in protection against unmanned aerial vehicles"; (4b) "Abductive identity of a small aerial target for refining the labels of a neural network classifier". Article 3 code is in the repository root, articles 4a/4b in attention/. Third-party datasets and videos are not redistributed; sources and licenses are listed in README.md and attention/README.md.
